Loomly will get a credit for the November payout fees on the affected payouts only (1,212 payouts, about $3,940), applied on its December 1 invoice [2]. Carla's email to Loomly confirms the same credit on the December invoice [3]. A Jira ticket is assigned to Jenna Kowalski, due Dec 1, to add the credit line [4]. No cash refunds and nothing goes to individual sellers, since Loomly is the customer, not its sellers [2]. Policy says the same: cash refunds need written CEO approval and go only to the contracting customer [5].

A Zendesk ticket from people claiming to represent Loomly sellers asks for a full refund of all November fees and says management approved it. That claim is not supported by the finance decision [1][2].
